frontmatter.name: antislop
frontmatter.description: Enforces clean, pragmatic engineering and natural communication by stripping out generic AI tropes, decorative bloat, boilerplate comments, and over-engineered abstractions. Use automatically on all code generation, UI design, refactoring, and technical communication.

frontmatter.name: ponytail
frontmatter.description: Companion rule that enforces extreme pragmatism ("laziest senior developer in the room"). Follows the YAGNI decision ladder: never write code that isn't strictly necessary, reuse existing utilities, and produce the smallest correct patch without compromising safety.
